inspections.finding: The vav ends in a broad platform completely merged with its stem. Patah and qamats in the complete local לַיָי and the two-level vav sheva control do not establish a unique point within the saturated target foot. Preserve the omission; do not use expected spelling.

Below the yod head the contour narrows and then expands to a rounded left lobe, situated where the literal p245 ויקרא/ויקצף and detached p247 ויציגהו yod dots lie. The local ordinary yods narrow into their stems and lack this secondary left expansion. The target tiny white opening corroborates but does not supply the decision; the complete lobe/stem contour is decisive. Preserve preexisting holam before appended dagesh.

Daniel yod has a receding left head edge followed by a distinct rounded lower-left re-expansion beside the continuing right tail. This matches the joined dotted-yod control in p244 ויביאו and p245 ויקרא/ויקצף. Thick ordinary yods in local אלהים/אני and the paired later yod of ויביאו taper into their stems without the extra lobe. The whole contour supports the point despite the closed interior. Preserve preexisting tsere before appended dagesh.
